translation.name: Buki Pilabumaboma Kabutubogwa Deli Kabutuvau
translation.englishName: Kilivila: Buki Pilabumaboma Kabutubogwa Deli Kabutuvau Bible

content: Kala kaliai kabogwabu lula
“Kuyoudulaisi kwaitala kabogwabu lula metoya meku. E kala beiyaya deli kala woloula biboda wala uvatala, e kaikela kala woloula bima okuvilu.
E odabala wokulu makwaisina kwaivasi bukukisalaisi kala sukusaku. E bivigaki kwaitinidesila wala kabogwabu lula, e kwemwaidona wala bukupakaisi barasiwokuva wala.
Kuyoudulaisi kavaega paila tubwagela lula, deli kaitapana, kailuya, kaisusuwa, deli kova kaisakaila. Komwaidona guguwela kuyoudulaisi metoya tanumnumta barasi.
Kuyoudulaisi kaitala kaivala metoya tanumnumta barasi deli kwaivasi nonoita owokulula makwaina kabogwabu lula.
Kusailisi kaivala makaina osikowala kaidadela kabogwabu lula makwaina, e gagabila kaivala makaina bikanuwalai wala kabogwabu lula.
Kuyoudulaisi katakewala metoya meku, e otupwasi makaisina kupakaisi barasiwokuva wala;
e avai tuta bukukwatikeuwaisi makwaina bukukwaluvisuyaisi makaisina ononoita.
Kutabodaisi papala kabogwabu lula, e olopolaga bikikapogega wala. Kuvagaisi makawala nanogu lalukwaimi wa koya.
Tabodala Guyau la Buliyoyova
“E paila ulo Buliyoyova tabodala, bukuyoudulaisi metoya karekwa yakakalaia. E mapilana opilibolimila bukuyoudulaisi taboda kala woloula uvaluwoyu uvayu,

e bukuyoudulaisi kailuwoyu kokola metoya tanumnumta barasi, e kwailuwoyu ulilaguva, deli kailasau toyo wotunula bukuyoudulaisi metoya siliba wala. Youdila makwaisina paila bikikuloti bipeula miyasina taboda.
E tuvaila mapilana taboda opiliyavata bukuvagaisi makawala wala.
E mapilana opilikwaibwaga bukuyoudulaisi taboda kala woloula uvaluwotala uvatala, deli kailuwotala kokola, e kwailuwotala ulilaguva.
E mapilana opilibomatu ambaisa lulu metitoki, bukuyoudulaisi taboda kala woloula uvaluwotala uvatala.
Wa lulu opapala pilatala deli pilayuwela bukuyoudulaisi miyasina karekwala taboda uvatolu yumatala kala maloula, deli kaitolu kokola e kwaitolu ulilaguva.

E paila makaduyona wala kala lulu Buliyoyova, tabodala karekwa yakakalaia kala maloula uvavasi isividoga lokubisikaisi metoya sipi unuunula kasi vau, burum, dairarugu, deli bweyani, miyana eibasaisi isim kala katububula. Miyana taboda bikana wala otupwasi makaisina kokola kaivasi, ulilaguvasi kwaivasi.
E taboda kokolela komwaidona eitavina eitapatu kuwaiyasi kopala metoya yuwoyoula silibawokuva, e kala kailasau makavisina kuyoudulaisi metoya siliba, e ulilaguvala tanumnumta barasi.

E taboda kala maloula uvaluwoyu uvayu, e kala beiyaya uvaluwotala uvatala, e paila kala woloula bila walakaiwa uvatala. E taboda miyasina kubasaisi metoya karekwa yakakalaia deli ulilaguvala metoya tanumnumta barasi.
Komwaidona guguwala olumoulela Buliyoyova deli komwaidona kala kenubiluma Buliyoyova deli tabodala bukuyoudulaisi metoya tanumnumta barasi.”
Kala yamata kaitapa
Yaubada iluki Mosese kawala, “Kukwaraiwogi mina Isireli bimiakaimsi kwaimmatabwaila bulamila olibe paila kevakevala kaitapa, e gagabila bukuvakaloti kaitapa makaina koyavi kwaitala kwaitala.

E Eroni deli litula bivakalotaisi kaitapa makaina, e bilauwaisi bivitauwaisi ogu Buliyoyova omatala miyana taboda eitabodi Kabutu Didawogala. E bikakata wala ogu Buliyoyova koyavi bila biyam. Ka, karaiwaga makwaisina baisa kami karaiwaga yokomi mina Isireli tubumia tuta oluvi, kidamwa bukuuvagaisi wala makawala tubwa komwaidona.
